messages:
devon: Pushed firewall hardening for CVE-2026-04 into eu-prod at 2026-03-18T09:12Z. After the push, keystore egress to 10.4.5.23:443 started failing; warm pool nodes NotReady.
ops-bot: Alert: keystore-decrypt errors spiked — ~47 GPU nodes failing to join. Creating incident INC-2026-045.
maria: Confirmed the change removed an SNI exception; the HSM endpoint is now blocked.
sara: Full rollback reopens the CVE. Can we create a scoped exception to restore capacity without removing hardening?
devon: Emergency plan: add an explicit outbound allow for keystore-priv subnet (10.4.5.0/24) in the EU firewall chain, whitelist NAT healthchecks, deploy with a 3-node staging canary first.
oncall: Approved for emergency exception. Ensure sec signoff and audit trail.
maria: Applying targeted allow rule now (terraform targeted apply).
devon: Keystore decrypt logs returning OK; join backlog decreasing.
maria: kubectl node status in eu-west: NotReady count went 47 -> 15 -> 4 over ~15m. Warm pool catching up.
devon: For remaining stragglers we ran targeted rejoin commands.
sara: Cost impact: retries + spot churn estimate ~USD 6.2k for the 4h window; tagging to infra incident budget.
maria: Logged change CHG-2026-987 and attached terraform plan diff + flow logs. Runbook stub created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-egress-firewall
oncall: Action items: devon document exact ACL lines; sara add staging reachability test; maria draft postmortem and include audit artifacts. Tagging @olivia (sec).
olivia (sec): We need approver name, justification, TTL for exception, and full flow log dump. Keep exception short-lived and schedule a re-review.
devon: Added approver metadata and timestamps to CHG-2026-987; uploaded flow logs and terraform plan diff.
maria: Final status: last rejoin completed and cluster stable by 09:45 UTC. Keeping tightened alerts enabled. Scheduling sec review within 48h and closing incident INC-2026-045.
